headline: Soak in Hot Springs and Explore Elephant Butte Lake
reservation: While public entry to the town is open, individual bathhouses and historic spas operate on private reservation systems for private soaking sessions. Overnight accommodations in the Hot Springs Historic District fill quickly during peak winter months; check official lodging sites for specific cancellation and booking windows.

days.title: Chihuahuan Desert Waters
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM from the Historic District

stops.name: Elephant Butte Lake State Park
stops.detail: Visit the largest reservoir in New Mexico to walk the dam overlook or explore the sandy shorelines of the High Desert.

stops.name: Turtle Mountain
stops.detail: View the prominent peak that gives the town its original name and explore the surrounding arid trailheads.

days.driving: Allow 30–60 minutes for local lake access; conditions vary.
days.note: State Park water levels fluctuate significantly by season.

days.title: Historic Soaks and Space History

stops.name: Geromino Springs Museum
stops.detail: Examine the Apache artifacts and the town's famous 1950s radio show name-change history.

stops.name: Hot Springs Historic District
stops.detail: Walk the downtown loop to select a historic bathhouse for a therapeutic mineral soak in natural geothermal waters.

days.driving: Primarily walking within the downtown core.
days.note: Check individual spa hours as many close for mid-day maintenance.

days.title: Southern Rio Grande Vistas

stops.name: Caballo Lake State Park
stops.detail: Drive south to view the majestic Caballo Mountains reflected in the quieter waters of the Rio Grande.

stops.name: Percha Dam State Park
stops.detail: Stop at this renowned birding location where the river is shaded by ancient cottonwood trees.

days.driving: Allow 1.5 hours for the roundtrip loop; conditions vary.
days.note: High winds in spring can affect visibility and lake access.

intel.title: Spa Availability
intel.text: Walk-in soaking is rare during holiday weekends in the Historic District. Always verify current operating hours for public bathhouses before arrival.

intel.title: Highway Services
intel.text: Fuel is reliable along the I-25 corridor near Truth or Consequences. Supply options decrease rapidly once traveling east toward the mountains.

intel.title: State Park Boat Ramps
intel.text: Parking at Elephant Butte can be congested during summer weekends near the main marina. Arrive early to secure space for larger vehicles.

intel.title: Canyon Connectivity
intel.text: Cellular coverage is generally strong in town but drops significantly in the canyons surrounding the Rio Grande. Download offline maps for desert excursions.

intel.title: Seasonal Heat
intel.text: Mid-day temperatures in the Chihuahuan Desert are extreme from June to August. Plan outdoor activities for the early morning hours.

plan.arrival: Pick up a vehicle at Las Cruces or Albuquerque; stock up on water and supplies in town before heading to the state park campgrounds.
plan.vehicle: Standard sedans are suitable for the town and main park roads; high-clearance vehicles are recommended for back-country desert tracks.
plan.goldenHour: Sunset views are best from the Elephant Butte Dam overlook during the autumn months.
